text: Every March creature leaves something behind: a fang, a scale, a tuft of wool. Those are **reagents**, and they are how Tribal Power turns hunting into magic.

Keep a **{item:tribalpower:reagent_pouch}** on your hotbar and every reagent you pick up goes straight into it. The pouch holds up to **999** of each kind, raw and empowered, so it never fills your bags.

A reagent starts **raw**. At a [Song Bench](song_bench) you can **empower** it for 16 Pulse. Raw reagents brew remedies and go into a few recipes; empowered ones write songs, fletch verse arrows and anoint weapons.

pages.title: Families
text: What a reagent does depends on its **family**, which comes from the creature it came off. There are eleven, and each means the same thing wherever you use it:
- in a **song**, what a reagent adds after the first one;
- in an **anointed weapon**, what the weapon does to whatever it hits ([Anointing](anointing));
- in a **remedy**, what the brew does for whoever takes it ([Remedies](remedies)).
The next pages list every family, which reagents belong to it, and what it does in each of the three.

Grind a raw reagent in a **bowl** with a single stick of **Ritual Chalk** (put all three in a crafting grid; a whole stack of chalk will not do) and you get **2 dye**. The bowl comes back, and the chalk only loses one mark.
Sixteen reagents make the sixteen dyes:
pages.title: Reagent dyes
Ember
text: **Reagents**: Ember Heart, Ember Mote, Magma Scale, Cinder Plate, Slag Curd, Slag Hide.
- **Anointing**: Searing: burns the target and adds fire to every blow.

pages.title: Bolt
text: - **Anointing**: Stormcall: a quarter of blows arc lightning into two nearby hostiles.

pages.title: Chill
text: - **Anointing**: Frostbite: slows and freezes the target.

pages.title: Venom
text: **Reagents**: Reed Fang, Gnasher Tooth, Facet Barb, Rime Mandible, Shard Barb, Brine Fang.
- **Remedy**: Antidote: lifts poison, wither, hunger and nausea.

pages.title: Gust
text: - **Anointing**: Gale: hurls the target back and up.

pages.title: Root
text: - **Anointing**: Rooting: a fifth of blows root the target in place.

pages.title: Shove
text: **Reagents**: Prism Carapace, Scree Knuckle, Ember Fang, Reed Whorl, Troll Hide, Rime Hide.
- **Anointing**: Sundering: blows bite harder the more armour the target wears.

pages.title: Weave
text: - **Anointing**: Echo: a quarter of blows strike a second time for half.
- **Remedy**: Clear Sight: Night Vision, lifts blindness.

pages.title: Weaken
text: **Reagents**: Sentinel Sigil, Pale Fang, Barrow Shroud, Drowned Weed.
- **Remedy**: Restoring: Haste, lifts weakness and slowness.

pages.title: Hound
text: **Reagents**: Rift Tooth, Lurker Claw, Goblin Ear, Goblin Fang, Kobold Scale, Kobold Horn.
- **Anointing**: Bloodthirst: life steal, 15% of every blow comes back as health.

pages.title: Quiet
text: **Reagents**: Dawn Velvet, Lantern Down, Mossback Scale, Ash Tuft, Grazer Wool, Glimmer Dust, Flitter Wing, Bounder Horn, Grub Husk, Tuft Wool, Shank Sinew, Pale Down, Crag Fleece, Boulder Tusk, Drift Bladder, Prism Crest, Shard Wing, Glow Husk, Drift Pelt, Frost Hoof, Snow Veil, Ash Wing, Marsh Foot, Fen Hoof, Bog Bladder, Chime Crest, Glass Wing, Geode Husk, Silt Fin, Pale Streamer, Shoal Scale, Hearth Bark, Elder Bark, Frostpine Bark, Cinder Bark, Weeping Knot, Bellcap Spore, Stilt Root, Fay Dust, Fay Petal, Fay Spark.
- **Song**: gives you a moment of regeneration.
- **Anointing**: Mending: the weapon repairs itself as it strikes.
